Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Experience leading a project or feature area from design through delivery.
Experience operating software in production, including monitoring, debugging, and incident response.

Experience migrating users and data from an off-the-shelf system to in-house software.
Strong product sense and experience working directly with engineering, manufacturing, or operations users.
Experience with Go, infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), and GitOps.
Background in aerospace, defense, or another regulated, hardware-driven domain.
